checks.evidence: The numeric range order, supplied catalog branch, registry serialization, and ledger ordering are correct. The supported scale-manifest path and malformed-value path can bypass the bounded contract, and normal non-MTF RB outputs lack the digest that the new Phase 5 loader requires (gpu_fuzzy_trader/features/fuzzy_scaling.py:149-175; gpu_fuzzy_trader/phases/phase5_oos.py:814-828; gpu_fuzzy_trader/rb_governor.py:531-562,5135-5175).

The sealed tests pass, but the new tests mostly construct valid digest-bearing fixtures. They do not exercise the normal RB writer, malformed on-chain values, the scale-manifest override, missing MTF/Phase 2/RB digests, MTF composition rebuild, or list-shaped MTF archives (tests/unit/test_mtf_pipeline_integration.py:264-290; tests/unit/test_phase5_oos.py:52-72,475-489; tests/unit/test_phase2_rule_pool.py:1174-1187).

The transitive impact reaches the unchanged rb_governor and output-writer contracts as well as Phase 5. The changed loader now rejects normal RB artifacts that those contracts still emit without a feature digest (gpu_fuzzy_trader/run_pipeline.py:3733-3746; gpu_fuzzy_trader/rb_governor.py:531-562,5135-5175; gpu_fuzzy_trader/output/writer.py:371-390).

Digest handling is not uniform: HWC/MWC rebuild, LWC silently empties, structured MTF payloads validate, list payloads bypass validation, and Phase 5 chooses the first truthy digest among several copies rather than enforcing one consistent artifact field (gpu_fuzzy_trader/run_pipeline.py:4416-4484; gpu_fuzzy_trader/mtf/archives.py:367-400; gpu_fuzzy_trader/phases/phase5_oos.py:816-828).

findings.title: Malformed supplied on-chain values are coerced to NaN
findings.description: validate_onchain_feature_ranges and bounded_continuous apply use pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce'). A non-null malformed value such as 'bad' is converted to NaN and accepted as warm-up data. fit_fuzzy_feature_scaling also skips object-typed on-chain columns before validation. This violates fail-closed raw supplied-frame validation while true NaN should remain allowed. Reject conversion failures separately from actual nulls.

findings.title: The explicit scaling-manifest path bypasses all-inf validation
findings.description: fit_fuzzy_feature_scaling returns FEATURE_SCALE_MANIFEST immediately at lines 173-175, so an all-infinite on-chain training column does not fail in this supported path. Validate the bounded inputs even when the scaling manifest is supplied.

findings.title: Normal RB outputs do not emit the digest required by Phase 5
findings.description: The new loader rejects an RB file with no recognized current digest at lines 814-828. The normal rb_governor _strategy output has no feature_contract_digest at rb_governor.py:531-562 and its accepted strategy is written directly at rb_governor.py:5135-5175. run_pipeline delegates the non-MTF/generated_lwc path to that writer at run_pipeline.py:3733-3746. Such a newly generated accepted strategy is therefore skipped by Phase 5. Stamp the digest at the normal RB output boundary and preserve it through any writer.

findings.title: Stale LWC archive handling does not rebuild
findings.description: When lwc_rules is None, a digest mismatch is caught at lines 4465-4484, but the stale archive is only ignored and no replacement discovery is run. In run_phase, the LWC load occurs before run_mtf_composition at lines 1785-1793 and the mismatch escapes. The requested MTF composition rebuild behavior is therefore incomplete for LWC.

findings.title: List-shaped MTF archives bypass digest enforcement
findings.description: load_mtf_rule_archive accepts a JSON list at lines 367-372, while load_mtf_archive_payload performs digest validation only for dict payloads at lines 387-400. A legacy list archive has no feature_contract_digest but is still reusable, contrary to the missing-digest rejection requirement.

findings.title: Required missing-digest and rebuild paths are not tested
findings.description: The MTF test covers only a structured archive whose current digest is later changed. The Phase 2 and RB tests likewise cover mismatch only, and there is no composition rebuild test or normal RB-writer integration test. Add missing-digest tests and exercise each production artifact path, including list rejection and LWC/HWC/MWC recovery.
